	<div class="comment even thread-odd thread-alt depth-1 vcard" id="comment-467203">
		<div class="comment-metadata">
			<p class="comment-permalink"><a href="https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2015/05/13/a-remark-on-the-lonely-runner-conjecture/#comment-467203" title="Permalink to this comment">23 March, 2016 at 9:53 pm</a></p>
			<p class="comment-author"><strong class="fn">David R</strong></p>
					</div>

		<div class="comment-content">
			<img referrerpolicy="no-referrer" alt="David R's avatar" src="https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=32&d=identicon&r=PG" srcset="https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=32&d=identicon&r=PG 1x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=48&d=identicon&r=PG 1.5x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=64&d=identicon&r=PG 2x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=96&d=identicon&r=PG 3x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/09520f4ff761213f95727843f6d934a0f3f4440d8cff289f251efedabd0f22da?s=128&d=identicon&r=PG 4x" class="avatar avatar-32 wp-hovercard-attachment grav-hashed grav-hijack" height="32" width="32" loading="lazy" decoding="async">			<p>What do you think of this argument Prof. Tao? Suppose we use the following three lemmas to prove the slowest runner <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="j " class="latex"> becomes lonely:</p>
<p>Lemma 1: Let <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="s_j < s_1 < \ldots < s_{k - 1}" class="latex"> for <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="k \geq 3" class="latex">. Then <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="j " class="latex"> becomes lonely if and only if there exists <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="n_1, n_2, \ldots n_{k - 1} \in \mathbb{N}" class="latex"> such that <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\bigcap_{i = 1}^{k - 1} \bigg [\frac{n_i + \frac{1}{k}}{s_i - s_j},  \frac{n_i + \frac{k - 1}{k}}{s_i - s_j}\bigg ] \neq \emptyset" class="latex"></p>
<p>Proof:: Straightforward in both directions.</p>
<p>Lemma 2: Let <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i%2C+b_i+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i%2C+b_i+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i%2C+b_i+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="a_i, b_i \in \mathbb{R}" class="latex"> and <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3C+b_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3C+b_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3C+b_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="a_i < b_i" class="latex">. Then <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk%7D+%5Ba_i%2C+b_i%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk%7D+%5Ba_i%2C+b_i%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk%7D+%5Ba_i%2C+b_i%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\bigcap_{i = 1}^{k} [a_i, b_i] \neq \emptyset" class="latex"> if and only if <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="b_i \geq a_i" class="latex"> for all <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2Cj+%5Cleq+k%2C+j+%5Cneq+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2Cj+%5Cleq+k%2C+j+%5Cneq+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2Cj+%5Cleq+k%2C+j+%5Cneq+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="1 \leq i,j \leq k, j \neq i" class="latex">..</p>
<p>Proof: (<img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CRightarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CRightarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CRightarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\Rightarrow" class="latex">). Proof by contradiction.<br>
(<img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CLeftarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CLeftarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5CLeftarrow&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\Leftarrow" class="latex">). Proof by contrapositive.</p>
<p>Lemma 3: Let <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="s_j < s_1 < \ldots < s_{k - 1}" class="latex"> for <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%5Cgeq+3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="k \geq 3" class="latex">.Then there exists <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="n_1, n_2, \ldots n_{k - 1} \in \mathbb{N}" class="latex"> such that</p>
<p><img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\frac{s_m - s_j}{s_i - s_j} \ge \frac{kn_m + 1}{kn_i + k - 1}" class="latex"> </p>
<p>for <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="1 \le i, m \le k - 1" class="latex">, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="m \ne i" class="latex">.</p>
<p>Proof: Try a proof by induction. Proving the base case <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%283%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%283%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%283%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="P(3)" class="latex"> follows easily from the fact that the LRC has been proven for <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%3D3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%3D3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=k+%3D3&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="k =3" class="latex">. Proving that <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%28k%29+%5CRightarrow+P%28k+%2B+1%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%28k%29+%5CRightarrow+P%28k+%2B+1%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=P%28k%29+%5CRightarrow+P%28k+%2B+1%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="P(k) \Rightarrow P(k + 1)" class="latex"> looks to be quite difficult though.</p>
<p>We can then make the following argument:</p>
<p>Theorem 1: Let <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+s_2+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D%2C+k%5Cge+3+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+s_2+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D%2C+k%5Cge+3+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=s_j+%3C+s_1+%3C+s_2+%3C+%5Cldots+%3C+s_%7Bk+-+1%7D%2C+k%5Cge+3+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="s_j < s_1 < s_2 < \ldots < s_{k - 1}, k\ge 3 " class="latex">. Then <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="j" class="latex"> becomes lonely.</p>
<p>Proof: By Lemma 3, there exists <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="n_1, n_2, \ldots n_{k - 1} \in \mathbb{N}" class="latex"> such that</p>
<p> <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cge+%5Cfrac%7Bkn_m+%2B+1%7D%7Bkn_i+%2B+k+-+1%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\frac{s_m - s_j}{s_i - s_j} \ge \frac{kn_m + 1}{kn_i + k - 1}" class="latex"> </p>
<p>for all <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="1 \le i, m \le k - 1" class="latex">, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="m \ne i" class="latex">. Hence, there exists <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n_1%2C+n_2%2C+%5Cldots+n_%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cin+%5Cmathbb%7BN%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="n_1, n_2, \ldots n_{k - 1} \in \mathbb{N}" class="latex"> such that  </p>
<p><img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cgeq+%5Cfrac%7Bn_m+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cgeq+%5Cfrac%7Bn_m+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D+%5Cgeq+%5Cfrac%7Bn_m+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_m+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\frac{n_i + \frac{k - 1}{k}}{s_i - s_j} \geq \frac{n_m + \frac{1}{k}}{s_m - s_j}" class="latex"></p>
<p>for all <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cle+i%2C+m+%5Cle+k+-+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="1 \le i, m \le k - 1" class="latex">, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=m+%5Cne+i&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="m \ne i" class="latex">. By setting</p>
<p><img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C+b_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C+b_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=a_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C+b_i+%3D+%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="a_i = \frac{n_i + \frac{1}{k}}{s_i - s_j}, b_i = \frac{n_i + \frac{k - 1}{k}}{s_i - s_j}" class="latex"></p>
<p>and because <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=b_i+%5Cgeq+a_m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="b_i \geq a_m" class="latex"> for <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2C+m+%5Cleq+k+-+1%2C+i+%5Cne+m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2C+m+%5Cleq+k+-+1%2C+i+%5Cne+m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=1+%5Cleq+i%2C+m+%5Cleq+k+-+1%2C+i+%5Cne+m&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="1 \leq i, m \leq k - 1, i \ne m" class="latex"> we have from Lemma 2,</p>
<p> <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cbigcap_%7Bi+%3D+1%7D%5E%7Bk+-+1%7D+%5Cbigg+%5B%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%2C++%5Cfrac%7Bn_i+%2B+%5Cfrac%7Bk+-+1%7D%7Bk%7D%7D%7Bs_i+-+s_j%7D%5Cbigg+%5D+%5Cneq+%5Cemptyset+&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\bigcap_{i = 1}^{k - 1} \bigg [\frac{n_i + \frac{1}{k}}{s_i - s_j},  \frac{n_i + \frac{k - 1}{k}}{s_i - s_j}\bigg ] \neq \emptyset " class="latex">.</p>
<p>By Lemma 1, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=j&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="j" class="latex"> becomes lonely for all T in the intersection.</p>
<p>The thing that’s interesting about this argument is that if we can prove Lemma 3, then we can repeat essentially the same argument to prove that runners with some intermediate speed as well as runners with the fastest speed become lonely. The argument for proving that the fastest runner becomes lonely would be almost identical to the argument for the slowest runner.</p>

But one test can come from the observation that the lonely runner conjecture is only barely true in the case <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_i%3Di&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_i%3Di&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_i%3Di&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="v_i=i" class="latex"> (as pointed out in above in the blog post) or permutations or affine transformations thereof.  As such, any proof of the lonely runner conjecture should also only barely work in this case (in particular, any key inequality in the proof should hold with equality in this case). 		<div class="comment-content">
			<img referrerpolicy="no-referrer" alt="dsp's avatar" src="https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=32&d=identicon&r=PG" srcset="https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=32&d=identicon&r=PG 1x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=48&d=identicon&r=PG 1.5x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=64&d=identicon&r=PG 2x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=96&d=identicon&r=PG 3x, https://0.gravatar.com/avatar/69be27588063abf832bcd853d49ace98ab14c63c060dc59d30b47cfdf551b82d?s=128&d=identicon&r=PG 4x" class="avatar avatar-32 wp-hovercard-attachment grav-hashed grav-hijack" height="32" width="32" loading="lazy" decoding="async">			<p>This will probably turn out to be a very stupid question, but anyway: I have been thinking about what happens when you replace the Euclidean distance in the lonely runner conjecture with the p-adic one, i. e., what can one say about the set of vectors of distances <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%28%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_1%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%2C+%5Cdots%2C+%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_n%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%28%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_1%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%2C+%5Cdots%2C+%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_n%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%28%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_1%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%2C+%5Cdots%2C+%7C%28e%5E%7B%5Cpi+i+v_n%7D%29%5Et+-+1%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="(|(e^{\pi i v_1})^t - 1|_p, \dots, |(e^{\pi i v_n})^t - 1|_p)" class="latex">, where <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_1%2C%5Cdots%2Cv_n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_1%2C%5Cdots%2Cv_n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=v_1%2C%5Cdots%2Cv_n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="v_1,\dots,v_n" class="latex"> are fixed rational numbers, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=t&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=t&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=t&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="t" class="latex"> ranges over <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmathbb%7BR%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\mathbb{R}" class="latex"> and <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%7C_p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%7C_p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%7C_p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="|x|_p" class="latex"> denotes the p-adic absolute value of <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="x" class="latex">? I’ve come up with something I can’t understand. I guess my (as I said, probably stupid) question boils down to this:</p>
<p>1) For an algebraic number <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="x" class="latex">, the product of all the p-adic absolute values of <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=x&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="x" class="latex"> equals <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7B%7Cx%7C%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7B%7Cx%7C%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cfrac%7B1%7D%7B%7Cx%7C%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\frac{1}{|x|}" class="latex">.</p>
<p>2) For any <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p%2Cx%2Cy&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p%2Cx%2Cy&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p%2Cx%2Cy&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="p,x,y" class="latex">, <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%2By%7C_p+%5Cleq+%5Cmax+%28%7Cx%7C_p%2C%7Cy%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%2By%7C_p+%5Cleq+%5Cmax+%28%7Cx%7C_p%2C%7Cy%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Cx%2By%7C_p+%5Cleq+%5Cmax+%28%7Cx%7C_p%2C%7Cy%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="|x+y|_p \leq \max (|x|_p,|y|_p)" class="latex"></p>
<p>So if <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=n&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="n" class="latex"> is a sufficiently large positive integer, since the Euclidean distance between, say, 1 and <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=e%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=e%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=e%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="e^{\frac{\pi i}{n}}" class="latex"> is smaller than 1, for at least one <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=p&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="p" class="latex">, we must have that the p-adic distance between the two numbers is <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%3E+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%3E+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%3E+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="> 1" class="latex"> by 1). But by 2), this distance is at most <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmax+%28%7C1%7C_p%2C%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmax+%28%7C1%7C_p%2C%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%5Cmax+%28%7C1%7C_p%2C%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p%29&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="\max (|1|_p,|e^{\frac{\pi i}{n}}|_p)" class="latex">, and <img src="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p+%3D+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002" srcset="https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p+%3D+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002 1x, https://s0.wp.com/latex.php?latex=%7Ce%5E%7B%5Cfrac%7B%5Cpi+i%7D%7Bn%7D%7D%7C_p+%3D+1&bg=ffffff&fg=545454&s=0&c=20201002&zoom=4.5 4x" alt="|e^{\frac{\pi i}{n}}|_p = 1" class="latex"> since it is a root of unity.</p>
<p>I hope this isn’t too far off topic.</p>
